# Vedara Care Polyclinic

Vedara Care Polyclinic (Vedara Care Polyclinic FZE) is a DHA-licensed polyclinic (licence 2509266) at Shop 4, Binghatti Azure, Al Barsha South Fourth, Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai, UAE. Open every day 9am-10pm. Phone and WhatsApp: +971 55 573 6312. Insurance: reimbursement only, with supporting documents, for all major UAE insurers.

## Departments
- General Practice: basic GP services. https://vedaracare.ae/doctors/dr-sanjida-islam-suchana
- Physiotherapy: back and neck pain, sports injury, post-surgery rehab, pelvic floor. https://vedaracare.ae/physiotherapy-jvc
- Ayurveda: consultations and classical therapies. https://vedaracare.ae/ayurveda-clinic-jvc
- Dermatology: acne, eczema, psoriasis, pigmentation, hair loss. https://vedaracare.ae/dermatology-clinic-jvc
- Aesthetic treatments: skin boosters, Profhilo, PRP facial, laser skin treatments. https://vedaracare.ae/skin-clinic-jvc
- Beauty and wellness: HydraFacial, OxyGeneo, Ayurvedic massage. https://vedaracare.ae/wellness-clinic-jvc
